period.heading: Period of Revelation.
period.text: Both its style and theme indicate that it was revealed during the middle stage of Prophethood at Makkah. Reading between the lines, one feels that a bitter conflict had begun between the, Holy Prophet and the disbelievers of Makkah, though the persecution by them had not yet become tyrannical.

source.name: Sayyid Abul A'la Mawdudi, Tafhim al-Qur'an (introduction to the surah)

theme.heading: Theme Topics
theme.text: The central theme of the surah is to invite disbelievers to accept Islam and follow the Message of the Holy Prophet.
